name: MineOre
description:
Your new Minecraft BE adventure begins here! 😎 Build, explore the world, and grow alongside your friends on our survival server.

Our spring update brings a fresh start: we’ve performed a world wipe and refreshed the game environment. These resets happen every 3–4 months, making room for new builds, fresh plans, and exciting competition.

Follow our VK group so you never miss any news or project updates! 🚀 In the meantime, invite your friends, hop onto the server, and start racing in our new vehicles. Who will be the first to reach the finish line? 🏁
